# ggsegTracula <img src='man/figures/logo.png' align="right" height="138.5" />

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/ggseg/ggsegTracula/workflows/R-CMD-check/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ggseg/ggsegTracula/actions)
[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/250281064.svg)](https://zenodo.org/badge/latestdoi/250281064)
<!-- badges: end -->

This package contains dataset for plotting the TRACULA white matter tracts with ggseg and ggseg3d.

Yendiki et al. (2011) _Automated probabilistic reconstruction of white-matter pathways in health and disease using an atlas of the underlying anatomy_. Front. Neuroinform. 5:23. [doi: 10.3389/fninf.2011.00023](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/22016733)

## Installation

We recommend installing the ggseg-atlases through the ggseg
[r-universe](https://ggseg.r-universe.dev/ui#builds):

```{r}
#| label: install-r-universe
#| eval: false
options(repos = c(
  ggseg = "https://ggseg.r-universe.dev",
  CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
))

install.packages("ggsegTracula")
```

You can install ggsegTracula from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

```r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("ggseg/ggsegTracula")
```

## 2D plotting

```{r}
#| label: 2d-plot
library(ggsegTracula)
library(ggseg)
library(ggplot2)

ggplot() +
  geom_brain(
    atlas = tracula(),
    mapping = aes(fill = label),
    position = position_brain(hemi ~ view),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tracula()$palette, na.value = "grey") +
  theme_void()
```

## 3D plotting

```{r}
#| label: 3d-example
#| eval: false
library(ggseg3d)

ggseg3d(atlas = tracula()) |>
  pan_camera("right lateral")
```

```{r}
#| label: 3d-snapshot
#| include: false
#| eval: !expr (file.exists(Sys.which("chrome")) || file.exists(Sys.which("chromium"))) && !nzchar(Sys.getenv("CI"))
library(ggseg3d)

ggseg3d(atlas = tracula()) |>
  add_glassbrain(hemisphere = "left") |>
  pan_camera("right lateral") |>
  snapshot_brain("man/figures/README-3d-plot.png")
```

```{r}
#| label: 3d-include
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr file.exists("man/figures/README-3d-plot.png")
knitr::include_graphics("man/figures/README-3d-plot.png")
```
